description: A PHP class defining an admin controller for managing anti-spam entries in the Opencart e-commerce system. It includes methods for listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting anti-spam keywords, and handles associated routing, permissions, and view rendering.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Admin controller class for managing anti-spam keywords within the Opencart CMS, supporting CRUD operations and routing logic.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the anti-spam management page, setting up the page view and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct requests to display the list of anti-spam entries.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered list of anti-spam entries, supports pagination, and renders the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the add/edit form for an anti-spam entry, pre-populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or update an anti-spam entry, with permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected anti-spam entries after permission validation.
